name: Vigormortis
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. Minions you kill keep their ability & poison 1 Townsfolk neighbor. [-1 Outsider]
setup: -1 Outsider: replace one Outsider token with a Townsfolk token (no change if no Outsiders would be in play).
interaction: Points at a player, who dies. If that player is a Minion, they get HAS ABILITY and the Storyteller poisons the nearest Townsfolk neighbour clockwise or anticlockwise (Storyteller picks).
drunk_or_poisoned: The kill fails; killed Minions lose their kept ability and their Townsfolk neighbours are healthy while the Vigormortis is drunk or poisoned.

jinxes.text: A Mastermind that has their ability keeps it if the Vigormortis dies.

rulings.text: A killed Minion keeps its ability only while the Vigormortis is alive and has its ability; afterwards the poisoned Townsfolk recover.
The poisoned neighbour skips Outsiders, Minions and Travellers; it is always a Townsfolk and may be dead.
Only Minions the Vigormortis kills keep their ability; Minions executed by day do not.
A dead Minion that becomes a non-Minion, or is drunk or poisoned, has no ability (and poisons no one) for that time.

test_scenarios.name: setup removes outsider
test_scenarios.setup: 8 players (base 5 Townsfolk, 1 Outsider, 1 Minion, 1 Demon) with Vigormortis

test_scenarios.name: killed minion keeps ability
test_scenarios.setup: Seats: Bob Chef, Eve Poisoner, Carol Empath; Alice Vigormortis
test_scenarios.expected: Eve dies with HAS ABILITY and still poisons each night; Storyteller also poisons Bob or Carol.

test_scenarios.name: neighbour skips outsider
test_scenarios.setup: Seats: Gus Mayor, Dave Saint, Eve Witch, Fay Monk
test_scenarios.expected: The poisoned Townsfolk is Fay or Gus, never Dave.

test_scenarios.name: vigormortis dies
test_scenarios.setup: Eve dead Witch with HAS ABILITY, Carol poisoned by it
test_scenarios.actions: Day 3: Alice Vigormortis executed, no Scarlet Woman.
test_scenarios.expected: Good wins; Eve's ability and Carol's poisoning end.

test_scenarios.name: mastermind jinx
test_scenarios.setup: Eve Mastermind killed by the Vigormortis night 2
test_scenarios.expected: Eve keeps the Mastermind ability: the game continues for one more day.
